title: Projecting one vector onto another
subtitle: proj<sub>b</sub> a = (a·b / ‖b‖²) b, and the residual that is left over.

intro.idea: The projection of a onto b is the multiple of b closest to a. What is left, a − proj<sub>b</sub> a, is perpendicular to b.
intro.why: Least squares, PCA and Gram–Schmidt are all built from this one operation.
